resources.string: View interface details, copy IP addresses, and share the active proxy over Wi-Fi tethering or LAN.

Enable sharing, then enable the phone hotspot in Android settings and connect the other device. Enter the tethered interface IP and proxy port in that device’s HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy settings. Sharing also works over your LAN.
Sharing listens on all IPv4 interfaces. Listed endpoints reflect the active listener; access from another device also depends on its network and the phone’s hotspot/firewall settings.
This profile uses a full custom configuration. Configure its mixed or HTTP listener in the profile to enable sharing.
Applying sharing settings and restarting NekoBox+…
Sharing settings saved. Start NekoBox+ to apply them.
Sharing could not be applied. Check the connection and any custom listener overrides, then try again.
Local network permission is required for proxy sharing. Settings were not changed.
Local network permission is required to accept connections from other devices.
NekoBox+ is disconnected. No active proxy endpoints.
No active mixed or HTTP proxy listener.
Some interface details could not be read. Android may restrict interface, MAC, route, or DNS information.
No accessible network interfaces found. Try refreshing.
Proxy address for devices on this network
Local endpoint; external reachability is not established
Link-local IPv6: the other device must use its own interface scope, not the phone’s interface name.
Authentication required. Use the credentials configured for this listener (Settings → Inbound for the default proxy, or the custom profile configuration).
Enable sharing to proxy hotspot and USB tethering traffic automatically in TPROXY mode. Enable tethering in Android settings and connect the other device; no HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy setup is needed.
Uses the “Proxy tethered devices” setting and requires root. If tethering was already enabled, restart the hotspot to apply changes to tethering offload.
The local proxy is disabled in VPN mode. Enable sharing to create a mixed proxy for tethered devices.
The proxy only accepts local connections. Enable sharing to allow tethered or LAN devices to connect.
TPROXY capture of tethered traffic is disabled. Enable sharing to turn on “Proxy tethered devices”.
IPv6-only mode prevents TPROXY from capturing IPv4 tethered traffic. Enable IPv4 in the IPv6 settings.
This profile uses a full custom configuration. Automatic sharing changes are unavailable; configure its TPROXY tethering listeners and routing manually.
The running configuration does not match the sharing setting. Restart NekoBox+ to apply it.
